delicias_saucillo.definicion_anio: Agricultural year: from October 1 of the previous year to September 30 of the named year (kit v4, A3-M step 3; data/params.json, memoria.anio_actual)
delicias_saucillo.definicion_helada: Frost day: daily minimum temperature at or below 0 °C (kit v4, A2 step 1)

power.fuente: NASA POWER Daily API; community=AG, point 28.19 N −105.45 W (same MERRA-2 0.5°×0.625° and CERES 1° cell as the extended rectangle [-105.56, 28.07, -105.32, 28.19]); area delicias_saucillo

imerg.fuente: NASA GPM IMERG V07 (NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V07) via Google Earth Engine; mean of the half-hourly rates of the UTC day × 24, averaged over the delicias_saucillo rectangle [-105.56, 28.07, -105.32, 28.19]; 2001-01-01 to 2026-11-13

ecostress.fuente: NASA ECOSTRESS ECO_L3T_JET.002 («ECOSTRESS Tiled Evapotranspiration Instantaneous and Daytime L3 Global 70 m V002», Hook and Halverson 2024, DOI 10.5067/ECOSTRESS/ECO_L3T_JET.002, NASA LP DAAC); daily ET (ETdaily: median of four models of the instantaneous latent heat flux, scaled to the daylight hours, sunrise to sunset) at 70 m, collection 2, via AppEEARS v3.137 (AppEEARS Team 2026, «Application for Extracting and Exploring Analysis Ready Samples (AppEEARS). Ver. 3.137», NASA EOSDIS LP DAAC, USGS/EROS; point samples: requests raiz_ecostress_delicias_saucillo, ID 8d53d4fe-9e3f-48ee-8947-84078f3f8c99, and raiz_ecostress_lazaro_cardenas, ID 520f1233-5eb1-4c4e-b243-2c43940f784b, Nov 14, 2026; the README.md of each request, with both citations, unchanged in data/raw/reto/ecostress_readme_<zona>.md), one point inside each field, Oct 1, 2025 to Sep 30, 2026; a pass is used when ETdaily has data with cloud = 0 and water = 0, when no more than 25 % of the area's points are cloudy in that scene and when the pass falls between 0.15 and 0.85 of the daylight hours (assumptions [S] in supuestos.json); scenes less than 5 minutes apart are one overpass and are averaged; et_mm_dia = median of the overpasses of the month, n_escenas = number of overpasses; units: mm/day (user guide text and JPL code; its Table 10 says W/m²); overpasses with data in Oct, Dec, Jan (Delicias–Saucillo) and Aug, none used in May and Jul; extra columns zona, etc_modelo_mm (median, on the same days, of the A5 Kc times the NASA POWER ETo; classified fields within the crop cycle and, for annual crops, months in which HLS sees the field green), razon (et_mm_dia / etc_modelo_mm; different quantities, not a validation), et_min_mm_dia and et_max_mm_dia (lowest and highest overpass of the month) and incertidumbre_w_m2 (median ETinstUncertainty, W/m²: standard deviation among the four models at the pass; 29 to 231 over all clear passes, 10th to 90th percentiles); satellite estimate at 70 m on clear days, not a field measurement; raw AppEEARS output unchanged in data/raw/reto/ecostress_pasos_<zona>.csv; independent review of Nov 15, 2026 (docs/revisiones/2026-11-15_ecostress.md)

tarjetas.nota: SMAP radiometer observations assimilated into a land surface model (its root zone is modeled), and GLDAS, a land surface model. Regional grid cells, not field probes.

advertencias.texto: The SMAP series is the assimilated product: the satellite sees the surface layer, and the root-zone value comes from the model, not from a measurement.

tarjetas.nota: GRACE measures all the water stored (surface, soil and aquifer together) at basin scale. It does not separate the aquifer or the irrigation district.

advertencias.texto: GRACE is a basin series: one series for both pilot areas, the same in each. Its product grid is finer than the mascons it is built on, so the real resolution is the mascon's.

tarjetas.titulo: Greenness of the area, long record
tarjetas.nota: Mean greenness of the whole area. The field-by-field record comes from HLS.
Independent estimates of evapotranspiration at regional scale.

advertencias.texto: MODIS, GLDAS and SSEBop: a comparison, not validation. None of them measures the water of one field, and none changes the water need the page computes.

contraste.titulo: Monthly contrast with the modeled demand
contraste.nota: Modeled crop demand and SSEBop cover the rectangle named in their source. MODIS and GLDAS are means over the whole pilot area. The two areas can differ.

columnas.et_modelo_mm: Modeled crop demand (FAO method with NASA POWER)

tarjetas.nota: A second source next to NASA POWER, to bound its uncertainty.

advertencias.texto: NLDAS potential evaporation is not the FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration (ETo) of NASA POWER: it is another quantity, so the two are not compared value by value.

tarjetas.nota: A second source next to NASA POWER, with the same definition of a frost day.

advertencias.texto: ERA5-Land is from ECMWF and the Copernicus Climate Change Service, not from NASA.

tarjetas.nota: Temperature of the land surface seen from the satellite, not air temperature.
